spec.name: GoldEMARocMomentumTrend
spec.hypothesis: XAUUSD exhibits persistent intraday momentum during London/NY overlap due to institutional order flow clustering around macroeconomic releases and ETF rebalancing. Retail traders often fade early moves or enter late on exhaustion; this strategy captures the initial acceleration phase by combining EMA trend alignment with Rate-of-Change (ROC) expansion, entering only when volatility confirms directional commitment. The losing side consists of mean-reversion scalpers and breakout chasers who misjudge the sustainability of the move.
spec.entry_logic: Long: Fast EMA > Slow EMA AND ROC(fast_ema, n) > roc_thresh AND current bar closes above fast EMA AND is_session('london_ny'). Short: Fast EMA < Slow EMA AND ROC(fast_ema, n) < -roc_thresh AND current bar closes below fast EMA AND is_session('london_ny'). Requires ATR > 0 for valid SL/TP.
spec.exit_logic: Stop loss set at max(5.0, atr * sl_mult) USD points from entry. Take profit set at max(1.5, atr * tp_mult) USD points. No trailing stop to preserve sample size and avoid overfitting.
spec.expected_failure_conditions: Extended low-volatility consolidation outside major sessions or during holiday-thinned liquidity periods where ROC fails to exceed threshold despite EMA alignment.

details.detail: Bit-identical signal tapes produced on two independent runs with seed=42.
Verified signal identity T_c[0..c] == T_full[0..c] across 20 cut points (tolerance 1e-9).
